MCPOAuth.agentMcpIntro: Connect AI tools to read this Project's knowledge and, with explicit consent, add new raw sources. Access can be revoked at any time.
MCPOAuth.setupTitle: Connect an AI tool to this Project
MCPOAuth.setupIntro: Every guide uses this Project's current resource URL. Saving client settings does not prove a connection. Sign in in the client's browser and review the account, Project, and exact requested scope before approving. Clients requesting mcp:raw:write can add Markdown sources and import URL extractions only when the extracted content is clearly usable; re-importing the same URL refreshes its existing entry. This permission does not allow arbitrary raw file edits or deletes, and it does not verify facts. Never paste passwords, keys, or tokens into chat. Copied commands use POSIX shell quoting (zsh/bash); use the official docs to enter the same URL in PowerShell.
MCPOAuth.productNotVerified: LWC login and query not tested

codex.title: Codex CLI, app, and IDE
codex.body: Run these commands in a local terminal. Codex CLI, app, and IDE on the same host share MCP configuration; ChatGPT web uses a separate cloud connector. Finish the browser sign-in, then check /mcp in Codex. A saved configuration is not proof that LLM Wiki Cloud connected.
codex.evidence: Official setup docs and installed Codex CLI help (0.162.1) were checked. An earlier isolated config-save probe used 0.153.0 and did not contact LWC. Native LWC OAuth, tool discovery, and Project Query are NOT RUN.

openaiWeb.title: ChatGPT app / Dot web (shared web flow)
openaiWeb.body: Use the web client's Plugins area to add a custom MCP server and complete its OAuth consent; account plan, workspace permissions, and client UI can affect availability. The prompt below describes your connection intent but does not add or authorize the server. This web setup is separate from local Codex configuration.
openaiWeb.evidence: OpenAI's official guide describes custom MCP setup from Plugins for supported ChatGPT Business and Enterprise/Edu workspaces; workspace roles and permissions apply. The shared Dot flow is Owner-confirmed but was not independently inspected. Dot installation/OAuth, LWC OAuth, tool discovery, and Project Query are NOT RUN.

grok.title: Grok CLI and xAI Grok Bot
grok.body: These are separate clients. The CLI uses local Grok Build configuration; Grok Bot is a cloud service and does not read that configuration. Use the section that matches the client you are setting up.
grok.cliBody: Run the command in a terminal. In Grok Build, open /mcps, select llm-wiki, and press i to start the client's browser OAuth flow. Review the current account, Project, and query-only permission before approving.
grok.cliEvidence: Official setup docs and installed Grok CLI 1.0.52 help were checked. An isolated config-save probe did not contact LWC. Native LWC OAuth, tool discovery, and Project Query are NOT RUN.
grok.botBody: Ask Grok Bot in its conversation to add MCP for the data you specify. Replace the bracketed purpose before sending; the current Project URL is included. This Owner-provided message expresses connection intent and does not prove server setup or authorization.
grok.botEvidence: This request template reflects the Owner's reported Grok Bot use. Official Team Bot docs are linked for context; this session did not inspect the live Bot setup or connect LWC. Native OAuth, discovery, and Project Query are NOT RUN.

claude-code.title: Claude Code
claude-code.body: Run this documented HTTP MCP command in a local terminal. Start Claude Code, use /mcp to select llm-wiki, and complete the browser sign-in it requests. Review the account, current Project, and query-only permission before approving.
claude-code.evidence: Official Claude Code setup docs were checked. Claude Code was not installed in the guide-review environment, so no local CLI help or runtime check is claimed. Native LWC OAuth, tool discovery, and Project Query are NOT RUN.

openclaw.title: OpenClaw
openclaw.body: Run these documented commands in an OpenClaw terminal. The saved definition uses Streamable HTTP and requests mcp:query plus mcp:raw:write; login starts the client's browser OAuth flow. The final doctor probe contacts the configured server, so treat its result as a client check, not LWC acceptance.
openclaw.evidence: Official OpenClaw setup and transport docs were checked. OpenClaw was not installed in the guide-review environment, so no local CLI help or runtime check is claimed. Native LWC OAuth, tool discovery, and Project Query are NOT RUN.

guide.rawText: We visited Qingting Restaurant in Taipei City’s Da’an District on the weekend. It serves home-style food and costs about NT$250–400 per person. There is a paid parking lot nearby, about a three-minute walk away. The restaurant has child seats, but the walkway is narrow. We did not check whether a stroller can pass.
guide.sourceBoundary: The note states the district, parking, child-seat, walkway, and stroller details. No detail is inferred from the restaurant name.

guide.conceptComparisonDescription: Both examples use the same note. With Profile, the writing and tags bring the stated family and parking details forward while keeping stroller access unknown.
guide.withoutBody:
Qingting Restaurant is in Taipei City’s Da’an District and serves home-style food at about NT$250–400 per person.

A paid parking lot is nearby, about a three-minute walk away. The restaurant has child seats and a narrow walkway; stroller access has not been confirmed.
guide.withTitle: Qingting Restaurant: family dining and parking
guide.withBody:
Family dining
Child seats are available. The walkway is narrow, and stroller access has not been confirmed. A child seat alone does not establish suitability for every family.

Parking
A paid lot is nearby, about a three-minute walk away. The note does not state the number of spaces or parking rates.

Restaurant basics
The restaurant is in Taipei City’s Da’an District, serves home-style food, and costs about NT$250–400 per person.
guide.unknownBoundary: Unknown information stays unknown, not a negative fact or a promise that a result will match. These fixed tags do not guarantee what a real system will produce.
guide.queryText: Find a restaurant in Taipei City’s Da’an District with parking information and child seats.
guide.queryBoundary: This is one prewritten question. No search, AI, compile, GPS, or distance request is sent. The example does not promise geographic hard filtering.
guide.updateBody: To apply a changed Profile to concepts that were already compiled, run a full recompile. Editing the Profile does not rewrite existing articles. Tags can update without a full recompile, and their progress is shown separately.

Pipeline.pipelineDesc: Upload or scrape content, then run the pipeline to generate sources and entries.
Pipeline.addContentDescription: Upload markdown files or scrape URLs to feed the wiki pipeline.
Pipeline.uploadHint: Upload one or more files to the raw/ directory (max 3 concurrent).
Pipeline.scrapeHint: Fetch and preview a web page before saving it as raw content.
Pipeline.urlAlreadySaved: This exact content already exists in raw/; no file changes were made.
Pipeline.urlProcessingSeparate: Run the Pipeline separately to process this raw page.
Pipeline.urlUnchanged: The raw article already has these exact bytes.
Pipeline.urlPreviewUnavailable: Could not prepare the URL preview; nothing was saved. Try again or use manual capture.
Pipeline.urlQualityCheckUnavailable: The page was fetched successfully, but the automatic quality check was unavailable and skipped. Review the content carefully before saving.
Pipeline.urlQualityCheckUnavailableSaved: The automatic quality check was unavailable and skipped. This page was saved from the candidate you reviewed.
Pipeline.urlConfirmationNotice: Nothing has been saved yet. Confirmation saves this exact preview without fetching the page again.
Pipeline.urlRejected: This page did not pass the content checks, so nothing was saved.
Pipeline.urlConflict: The matching raw content changed while this page was being prepared. Review raw/ before trying again.
Pipeline.urlUncertain: The storage result is uncertain. Check raw/ before retrying.
Pipeline.urlUnavailable: The page could not be safely fetched and checked. Paste Markdown or clip the page and upload a supported file.
Pipeline.urlManualCapture: Pages that require sign-in, JavaScript, or payment and pages blocked by anti-bot systems may need manual capture.
Pipeline.runDescription: Trigger the OLW pipeline to ingest, compile, and publish.
Pipeline.pipelineStages: ingest (analyze raw notes) → compile (synthesize wiki articles) → lint (check quality) → publish (auto-approve).
Pipeline.scheduledDescription: When enabled, eligible Projects are checked hourly. Each Project can receive at most one free automatic incremental run per UTC day, separate from the manual daily quota. A run may wait for a later check.
Pipeline.scheduledProfileNote: A Profile change does not rebuild existing articles; new or changed sources use confirmed guidance.
Pipeline.scheduledDisabled: Automatic checks are not configured for this environment.
Pipeline.scheduledNotChecked: No scheduled check has run yet.

scheduledSkip.busy: Skipped: another pipeline owns this Project
scheduledSkip.daily_entitlement_used: Skipped: today's automatic entitlement was used
scheduledSkip.ineligible: Skipped: Project or owner is not eligible
scheduledSkip.unavailable: Skipped: required project data is unavailable

Pipeline.noProject: Please select a project before running pipeline
Pipeline.fullNotice: Regenerates existing entries with the saved Profile guidance. Raw files and annotations are kept. Body-only edits to generated entries are not guaranteed to survive, and a full run usually takes longer.
Pipeline.fullConfirm: Full recompile regenerates existing entries. Body-only edits to generated entries may not survive; raw files and annotations are kept. This usually takes longer. Continue?
Pipeline.prereqFull: New or changed raw files are not required
Pipeline.fullUnavailable: Full recompile is unavailable or the full-mode quota does not allow it.
Pipeline.guidanceUnavailable: This execution's guidance version is not available yet
Pipeline.statusReadFailed: Pipeline status could not be read. Retrying automatically; an accepted run may still be active.
Pipeline.automationAdminDisabled: Automatic processing is disabled by the Admin. Saved sources remain pending until the Admin allows processing.
Pipeline.automationDescription: Changed raw source content starts an incremental Pipeline when both the Admin and Project switches are on. Saved content is not published or searchable until processing succeeds.
Pipeline.automationDisabledPending: Saved; automatic processing is disabled by the Admin or Project switch.
Pipeline.automationManualNote: Manual runs remain available independently of the auto-pipeline switches. The existing daily schedule also remains independent.
Pipeline.automationNoChange: Saved; no new automatic processing was queued for this save.
Pipeline.automationQueued: Saved and waiting for automatic processing; not yet published or searchable.
Pipeline.automationUnknown: Saved; processing status could not be confirmed.
Pipeline.automationUpdateFailed: Automatic processing settings could not be updated.
Pipeline.urlProcessingAutomatic: When both auto-pipeline switches are on, changed content is processed automatically; saved content is not searchable until publication succeeds.

CLILane.title: Connect your wiki with the CLI
CLILane.intro: Sync your local wiki’s raw/ folder to the cloud. After syncing, return to the web app and compile before searching. The CLI does not read content from other folders.
CLILane.agentNote: A person or agent with local command-execution ability can follow these steps; this page does not run commands on your computer.
CLILane.downloadDescription: Choose a platform manually. Downloads appear only after a matching release archive is available.
CLILane.versionCommand: After downloading and extracting, open a terminal in the extracted folder and run:
CLILane.loginDescription: The command uses this app’s Auth address. It prints a one-time URL and code; it does not approve itself.
CLILane.loginApproval: Open the printed URL and approve the CLI in the Web app.
CLILane.loginCode: If no browser opens, copy the URL and code printed by the CLI.
CLILane.loginComplete: Return to the terminal and wait for the sign-in complete message.
CLILane.folderDescription: Use the root of your existing wiki folder. The same init command works for a new or already connected raw folder.
CLILane.rootLabel: Absolute path to your wiki root
CLILane.rootHint: Use an absolute path. The example contains a replaceable user-name placeholder; it does not read your computer or create a folder. A quoted ~ is literal.
CLILane.rawScope: The CLI syncs files inside raw/. Do not add raw/ to this root path.
CLILane.sameInit: Copy the command, then run it in the directory containing the CLI. It prepares or confirms the binding; it does not upload files.
CLILane.recoveryGuidance: Recover only missing or unfinished metadata after verifying this is the same vault. Reauthorize only a revoked binding when the local host, project, wiki, and binding identity match; if anything differs, stop and verify instead.
CLILane.enterRoot: Enter a wiki root path to prepare this command.
CLILane.obsidianTitle: If your vault is in Obsidian
CLILane.obsidianDescription: On macOS, in Finder press Command+Shift+G and enter ~/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/, then select your Vault root folder. If that path is unavailable, reveal the existing vault in Finder; on other platforms use Show in file manager. Copy its absolute folder path; do not import or move the whole vault.
CLILane.syncDescription: Copy source material into raw/ first. Keep the original if you want; when it changes, update the copy in raw/ before pushing.
CLILane.syncOption: Also download files that exist only in the cloud (--sync)
CLILane.syncConflict: Changed local raw files update their matching cloud files. A concurrent change or source change stops with a non-zero result; review it and rerun.
CLILane.syncNoDelete: Deletes are not sent. --sync only fills cloud-only paths and does not overwrite local files.
CLILane.syncNoCompile: Push does not compile or run generation.
CLILane.syncReady: After push succeeds, return to the Web app and start generation before searching the new content.
CLILane.copyFailed: Could not copy the command. Select and copy it manually.
